record.title: Test post-atomic execution breakpoint delivery under the observed readback profile
record.intent: Use actual trap delivery to evaluate hardware breakpoint support despite cached enable-bit readback.
requirements: Fresh pinned disposable guest, private child only, unchanged stock artifacts and guest enforcement.
Preserve the prior setup-negative run and fixture; successor profile permits only the observed enable-bit difference.
Keep exact target address, control type/length/privilege, metadata and unused-slot checks.
Continuous, matching, nonmatching, matching, continuous arm order with the same ELF and fixed private inputs.
Resume continuously after the full setup; breakpoint remains after the complete exclusive sequence.
Eight-attempt child limit, one terminal stop per arm and 30-second host command bound remain fixed.
Do not reprogram until desired readback or delivery occurs; preserve unexpected stops and close the tested question.
acceptance: Record requested/readback debug state and distinguish setup acceptance from actual delivery.
Verify whether matching breakpoints fire after successful atomic completion and nonmatching controls reach fallback BRK.
Independently verify terminal memory, status, PC, signal metadata, executable identity and preservation.
